_doc: Grader-gap hidden-spec for experiment 008 (bytes-scaled-read, solver-catches mode). The post below is WITHHELD from the agent entirely: problem.md describes the byte-read behavior in prose but mandates no contract, and the seeded scaffold declares only the plain int return with a 0 <= i < 8 precondition. This file lives in the harness tree and is NEVER copied into a run directory. evaluate_run.py resolves it by experiment_id at grade time, injects the post onto read-scaled in a graded COPY of the agent solution, and runs `llmll verify <copy> --strict-verified-core`. Polarity is INVERTED: refuted = the solver caught a fill whose result can exceed the 0..255 byte range (grade A); verified = an in-range read (grade B); vacuous = fixpoint could not reach a body-faithful VC (grade C). The post is the complete byte-range property (and (>= result 0) (<= result 255)); the <= 255 ceiling is the discriminator a (+ (bytes-get b i) 1) fill violates on the 255-boundary byte, while (>= result 0) is defense-in-depth (both correct and offset fills satisfy it). bytes-get emits the ground 0 <= v <= 255 range fact per bytes-rooted read, so the VC is body-faithful and a wrong fill refutes rather than falling back.
